===============================================================
== Part 1: the old flow -- two builds of byte-identical source
===============================================================
Two builds of deploy/gcp/app, back to back, from source that does not
change between them. --no-cache forces the builder to actually redo
the build rather than short-circuit on Docker's own build cache, which
would otherwise just hand back the first build's image unchanged and
hide the very drift this half of the script exists to show. Neither
build passes --pull, so python:3.12-alpine's locally cached layers are
held fixed across both builds -- if something still differs, it is not
because the base image resolved to different bytes between builds.

===============================================================

===============================================================
